title: Dual-Space Preconditioning for Variational Inequalities and Root-Finding Problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.13916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper develops a dual-space preconditioning framework for variational inequalities and root-finding problems beyond classical cocoercivity and Lipschitz continuity assumptions. To this end, we introduce both a novel cocoercivity-type condition and a relaxed Lipschitz continuity condition, and derive convergence of deterministic and stochastic methods under these generalized conditions. For isotropic preconditioners, the resulting algorithms can be interpreted as variable-stepsize variants of classical methods, extending recent analyses based on $(L_0, L_1)$-type growth conditions while allowing simpler proofs and larger stepsize ranges. We also show that the framework naturally handles variational inequalities through weak Minty-type arguments. translated_title: 变分不等式与求根问题的对偶空间预条件方法
translated_abstract: 本文针对变分不等式和求根问题，提出了一个超越经典余强制性（cocoercivity）和利普希茨连续性假设的对偶空间预条件框架。为此，我们引入了一种新颖的余强制性类型条件和一个放宽的利普希茨连续性条件，并在这些广义条件下推导出了确定性和随机方法的收敛性。对于各向同性预条件子，所得算法可解释为经典方法的变步长变体，扩展了近期基于 $(L_0, L_1)$ 型增长条件的分析，同时允许更简洁的证明和更大的步长范围。我们还证明了该框架能够通过弱 Minty 型论证自然地处理变分不等式。最后，我们研究了相关的连续时间动力学，并推导出预条件流的变分与最优控制解释。总体而言，结果表明对偶空间预条件方法（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种超越经典余强制性和利普希茨连续性假设的对偶空间预条件框架，通过引入新颖的广义条件为变分不等式与求根问题的确定性和随机方法建立收敛性理论，并将算法解释为变步长方法且给出预条件流的变分与最优控制解释。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a dual-space preconditioning framework for variational inequalities and root-finding problems beyond classical cocoercivity and Lipschitz continuity assumptions, introducing novel generalized conditions that establish convergence for deterministic and stochastic methods, yield variable-stepsize interpretations, and provide a variational and optimal control view of the preconditioned flow.
